defects.description: RESOLVED during execution 2026-09-26: JDK 21, SDK, and emulator were available; APK built from origin/dev@d93388d; 48/49 scenarios exercised.
OPEN: start-failure surfacing still unconfirmed (S-043 INCONCLUSIVE); no error UI observed in any flow.
RESOLVED by S-044: platform-tap-while-tracking guard exists; taps ignored.
RESOLVED by S-047: confirmed no notes field in completion modal.
History/Shift render '$' per en-US device-locale rule (Currency Format card: 'Formatted based on driver locale'); quote/config surfaces hardcode 'Rp'. Noted inconsistency; not failed.
Version identity: APK versionName 0.1.0 vs in-app 'OnTheRoad 0.2.0' card.
Platform completion modal discards typed payout/quoted values on dismiss/reopen; direct modal quote (computed) survives (S-020).
After permission denial, GPS snap is a silent no-op (no system re-request, no settings guidance).
Trips 4/5 earnings ($500061.00/$800063.00) are tester keyboard-focus artifacts (verified: exactly-typed trip 6 saved $9000.00); history has no edit/delete path, so residue stands.
S-014: toggling custom fare back to auto leaves the stale override value driving the quote (persists across distance edits) until the override field is cleared first.
S-004/S-042: no foreground-service notification is posted while tracking (shade + SystemUI dump); GPS icon active, timer counts.
S-022/J-02: Shift aggregates stay all-zeros with completed direct and platform trips.
S-030: theme selection applies only after app force-stop + relaunch; no restart prompt.
S-031/S-013: Settings profile selection does not propagate to the Tracker booking form (still Default).
S-036/J-01: saved rates do not change live quotes; restart required (verified 27,500 stale vs 29,500 after restart).
